legacyOptions.textFormat: ARC size fell more than 10% within 5 minutes

spec.description: OpenZFS from node-exporter and smartctl_exporter: status, workload, cache, disks and memory. Each collapsed row holds the details for its topic.

spec.title: Pool health
spec.description: Worst pool state. Anything but ONLINE needs attention.

spec.expr:
max(max by (zpool) (
  (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="online"} == 1) * 0
  or (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="degraded"} == 1) * 1
  or (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="offline"} == 1) * 2
  or (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="removed"} == 1) * 3
  or (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="unavail"} == 1) * 4
  or (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="faulted"} == 1) * 5
  or (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="suspended"} == 1) * 6
))

spec.title: Busiest datasets
spec.description: Top 8 datasets by bytes moved. Sync writes are fsync / NFS COMMIT calls per second.

spec.title: HDD latency
spec.description: Median (filled) and slowest hard drive I/O time for reads and writes. A pulling-away slowest line is one bad disk.

spec.title: SSD latency
spec.description: Median (filled) and slowest SSD/NVMe I/O time for reads and writes. Expect well under 1 ms.

spec.title: Disk busy
spec.description: Share of time each disk had I/O in flight. Warm colours mean near saturation.

spec.title: Disk latency vs. peers
spec.description: The ten disks slowest against their model's median in the selected range. 1.0x is typical; check SMART on outliers.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, (((rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}[$__range]) + rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}[$__range])) / ((rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}[$__range]) + rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}[$__range])) > 0)) * on (instance, device) group_left (model) label_replace(node_disk_info{instance="$instance"}, "model", "$1", "model", "^([^-]+)-.*$") / on (model) group_left () quantile by (model) (0.5, ((rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}[$__range]) + rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}[$__range])) / ((rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}[$__range]) + rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}[$__range])) > 0)) * on (instance, device) group_left (model) label_replace(node_disk_info{instance="$instance"}, "model", "$1", "model", "^([^-]+)-.*$"))) and on (model) (count by (model) (((rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}[$__range]) + rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}[$__range])) / ((rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}[$__range]) + rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}[$__range])) > 0)) * on (instance, device) group_left (model) label_replace(node_disk_info{instance="$instance"}, "model", "$1", "model", "^([^-]+)-.*$")) > 1)))

spec.title: Where reads come from
spec.description: Client reads (line) against L2ARC and disk reads (stacked); the gap is RAM. Disk reads include prefetch and scrub.

spec.title: L2ARC lookups per hour
spec.description: RAM misses that checked the L2ARC: hits were served by it, misses went to disk.

spec.title: Free space
spec.description: Space left in each pool. ZFS slows down as a pool fills; keep 10-20% free.

spec.title: L2ARC feed
spec.description: Bytes written into the L2ARC from data near eviction. Heavy feed wears the cache SSDs.

spec.title: L2ARC
spec.description: Data cached on the L2ARC and the RAM spent indexing it.

spec.title: ARC size vs. target
spec.description: ARC size against its target (c), ceiling (c_max) and total RAM. Both dropping together is the kernel reclaiming ARC.

spec.title: RAM headroom
spec.description: Free memory as the ARC sees it. Above the dashed line it grows; below zero (red) it shrinks.

spec.title: Throttle delays
spec.description: Share of writes delayed each hour, by reason: dirty data, ZIL backlog, hard limit or low memory.

spec.title: ARC hits by list
spec.description: Where RAM hits were found. MFU: used repeatedly. MRU: used once recently. I/O hits: joined a read in flight.

spec.title: Errors
spec.description: New errors in the selected range: L2ARC, ZIL and fault reports from ZFS; media, CRC and failure counts from SMART.

spec.expr: sum((label_replace(increase(smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?",attribute_name=~"Reallocated_Sector_Ct|Current_Pending_Sector|Reported_Uncorrect|Offline_Uncorrectable|Uncorrectable_Error_Cnt|UDMA_CRC_Error_Count|CRC_Error_Count",attribute_value_type="raw"}[$__range]), "device", "${1}n1", "device", "^(nvme[0-9]+)$") and on (device) node_disk_info{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"})) + sum((label_replace(increase(smartctl_device_media_errors{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?"}[$__range]), "device", "${1}n1", "device", "^(nvme[0-9]+)$") and on (device) node_disk_info{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"})) + (count((label_replace(smartctl_device_smart_status{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?"} == 0, "device", "${1}n1", "device", "^(nvme[0-9]+)$") and on (device) node_disk_info{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"})) or vector(0))

spec.title: ARC misses and ghost hits
spec.description: Misses by type (stacked). Dashed: ghost hits, misses a larger ARC would have served.

spec.title: ARC contents by list
spec.description: What the ARC holds: MFU/MRU data and metadata, dirty buffers (anon) and uncached.

spec.title: Reclaim pressure
spec.description: How often the kernel took RAM from the ARC. Direct reclaim stalls the caller; kswapd runs in the background.

spec.title: ARC evictions
spec.description: Bytes evicted from RAM: still in L2ARC, lost to disk, or not eligible. Much lost means L2ARC filling lags.

spec.title: L2ARC contents by list
spec.description: L2ARC data by the ARC list it came from.

spec.title: ARC overhead
spec.description: RAM spent on bookkeeping instead of data: headers, L2ARC index, dbufs and dnodes.

spec.title: ARC compression
spec.description: Logical size of cached data against the RAM it uses. Buffer copies are decompressed copies handed to readers.

spec.title: ARC adaptive balance
spec.description: How the ARC splits RAM: actual (solid) against the target it adapts toward (dashed).

spec.title: Throughput by device class
spec.description: Bytes moved by HDDs (solid) and SSDs (dashed), including parity, scrub and L2ARC traffic.

spec.title: Cache hits
spec.description: RAM: reads answered from memory. L2ARC: RAM misses answered by the cache devices.

spec.title: Cache flush latency by disk
spec.description: Time to flush a drive's write cache, on the sync-write path. Drives with power-loss protection skip it.

spec.title: Sync write activity
spec.description: Sync commits, log records written, and stalls that waited for a full txg.

spec.title: Sync writes by vdev class
spec.description: Sync-write bytes logged to the ZIL, by where log blocks land. A special vdev acting as SLOG counts as normal.

spec.title: Prefetch streams
spec.description: How reads matched the prefetcher's sequential streams. Stream limit means no free slot.

spec.title: Prefetch use
spec.description: Prefetches issued against prefetched blocks a read actually used.

spec.title: dbuf and dnode hit ratio
spec.description: Metadata lookups served from memory.

spec.title: dbuf cache size
spec.description: dbuf cache size against its target and maximum.

spec.title: Eviction skips
spec.description: Evictions skipped because a buffer was locked, too young or being written to L2ARC. Sustained growth means eviction is struggling.

spec.title: Throttled
spec.description: Share of writes the throttle delayed. A fraction of a percent is normal.

spec.title: Pool states
spec.description: Each pool's state over time. Anything but ONLINE needs attention.

spec.expr:
max by (zpool) (
  (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="online"} == 1) * 0
  or (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="degraded"} == 1) * 1
  or (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="offline"} == 1) * 2
  or (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="removed"} == 1) * 3
  or (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="unavail"} == 1) * 4
  or (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="faulted"} == 1) * 5
  or (node_zfs_zpool_state{instance="$instance",zpool=~"$zpool",state="suspended"} == 1) * 6
)

spec.title: Space by dataset
spec.description: Space each dataset uses itself, without children or snapshots. Top 15.

spec.title: HDD request size
spec.description: Average request size for hard drives, reads and writes. Bigger requests take longer each.

spec.title: Throughput by disk
spec.description: Bytes per disk; reads up, writes down. Click a disk to focus the dashboard on it.

spec.title: IOPS by disk
spec.description: Requests per disk; reads up, writes down.

spec.title: HDD latency by disk
spec.description: Average I/O time per hard drive, reads and writes.

spec.title: SSD latency by disk
spec.description: Average I/O time per SSD/NVMe device, reads and writes.

spec.title: SSD request size
spec.description: Average request size per SSD/NVMe device, reads and writes. Per device, as each serves a different role.

spec.title: ARC size
spec.description: RAM held by the ARC now. It shrinks under memory pressure.

spec.title: I/Os in flight by disk
spec.description: Requests queued or in service per disk. A deep queue with high latency is a burst, not a slow disk.

spec.title: SMART health
spec.description: What each drive reports about itself. Counters should be 0: sector counts mean media, CRC and timeouts mean cabling.

spec.expr: label_replace(max by (device) (smartctl_device_percentage_used{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?"}) or max by (device) (100 - smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?",attribute_name=~"Wear_Leveling_Count",attribute_value_type="value"}), "device", "${1}n1", "device", "^(nvme[0-9]+)$") and on (device) node_disk_info{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}

label_replace(sum by (device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?",attribute_name=~"Reported_Uncorrect|Offline_Uncorrectable|Uncorrectable_Error_Cnt",attribute_value_type="raw"}) or max by (device) (smartctl_device_media_errors{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?"}), "device", "${1}n1", "device", "^(nvme[0-9]+)$") and on (device) node_disk_info{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}

label_replace(max by (device) (smartctl_device_num_err_log_entries{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?"}) or max by (device) (smartctl_device_error_log_count{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?",error_log_type="summary"}), "device", "${1}n1", "device", "^(nvme[0-9]+)$") and on (device) node_disk_info{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}

spec.title: Disk temperature
spec.description: Typical and hottest drive temperature; HDD solid, SSD dashed. Over 55 °C shortens any drive's life.

spec.expr: quantile(0.5, max by (device) (smartctl_device_temperature{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?",temperature_type="current"}) and on (device) (smartctl_device_rotation_rate{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?"} > 0) and on (device) node_disk_info{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"})

max(max by (device) (smartctl_device_temperature{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?",temperature_type="current"}) and on (device) (smartctl_device_rotation_rate{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?"} > 0) and on (device) node_disk_info{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"})

quantile(0.5, (max by (device) (smartctl_device_temperature{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?",temperature_type="current"})  and on (device) node_disk_info{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}) unless on (device) (smartctl_device_rotation_rate{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?"} > 0))

max((max by (device) (smartctl_device_temperature{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?",temperature_type="current"})  and on (device) node_disk_info{instance="$instance",device=~"$disk"}) unless on (device) (smartctl_device_rotation_rate{instance=~"$smart_host(:[0-9]+)?"} > 0))

spec.title: Client throughput
spec.description: Bytes clients read (up) and wrote (down), before the cache.

spec.title: Client IOPS
spec.description: Operations clients issued: reads up, writes down.

spec.title: Memory · ARC size, headroom, contents & overhead
